messages:
lex: FYI rolling out RBAC refactor scoped to Dedicated + Private control plane. Need quick sync on role mappings, audit fields, and a KMS exception for BYOK customers. @sam can you eyeball? :eyes:

sam: TL;DR of the changes? do we have a migration plan?

lex: Short summary: 
- rename `admin` -> `company_admin` to avoid collision with on-prem local admin.
- add `onprem_admin` (full cluster ops for private deployments) and `onprem_kms_admin` (KMS ops but no user mgmt).
- tighten VPC allowlist check order so it runs before auth header parsing.
- audit log: add `actor.ip`, `actor.principal`, `kms.key_id` for any KMS call.
- hotfix for control-plane bug where empty X-Forwarded-For bypassed allowlist.

Also sample mapping we plan to apply automatically: 
```
# mapping: old_role -> new_role
"admin": "company_admin"
"onprem_superuser": "onprem_admin"
"kms_ops": "onprem_kms_admin"
```
Will script: RBAC API bulk PATCH with dry-run first.

john: two Qs: (1) audit log retention for private customers? (2) KMS integration model for private control plane = Redwood-managed KEK or BYOK?

claudia: found an access-control bug in private control plane yesterday. repro: 
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <valid-token>" -H "X-Forwarded-For: " https://private-api.customer.example/v1/models
# returned 200 even though src ip wasn't in allowlist
```
Because the XFF header was empty the code path treated it as "no source" and fell back to internal trust. Not good. I pushed a small check in staging to reject empty XFF and fallback to remote_addr.

lex: Good catch. Plan: push hotfix to production canary group (two customers) today. Mitigation: reject requests with empty or whitespace-only XFF and ensure VPC CIDR check runs on the actual source IP (remote_addr) when XFF is malformed. I'll open a patch PR targeting the runtime layer.

sam: For role migration, can we do a safe two-step rollout? 1) create new roles and duplicate policies (no removal), 2) update service accounts and flows to prefer new role names, 3) after 14 days, remove old ones. We need a rollback path in case SSO/SCIM mappings break.

lex: Agreed. Migration steps (brief): 
1) create roles w/ same policy blob as old. run dry-run audit: `rbacctl migrate --dry-run --map map.json`
2) publish announcement and update SCIM mapping doc.
3) phased switch per-tenant via `rbacctl set-preference --tenant <id> --role-mapping-file rmap.json`
4) monitor audit logs for denied requests >=5% baseline -> rollback.

audit-bot: SECURITY-TICKET-2025-148 created: "private control plane XFF bypass + RBAC refactor" assigned to @lex and @claudia.

claudia: KMS notes: customers want BYOK for private control plane. That means we need: 
- KMS auth delegation so customer keys can be used without exposing keys to Redwood.
- audit events for any `Encrypt`/`Decrypt`/`Sign` operations must include `kms.key_id` and `requester_principal`.
- authorization: only `onprem_kms_admin` (or explicit tenant IAM) can call `kms:UseKey` on their tenant's key.

john: I strongly prefer separating KMS admin perms. If we give `onprem_admin` KMS rights we risk lateral movement. Proposal: create `onprem_kms_admin` and `onprem_security_auditor` (read-only logs + KMS read).

lex: OK we'll split. Action owners: 
- @claudia: implement XFF guard + unit tests + staging deploy (today).
- @lex: prepare RBAC migration script + documentation + PR (blocks: SCIM mapping samples).
- @sam: coordinate canary customers and signoff criteria.
- @john: define KMS role policy JSON for onprem_kms_admin and onprem_security_auditor.

sam: test checklist request: please make sure we have: 
- unit tests for XFF parsing and VPC allowlist logic.
- e2e test that a BYOK KMS request logs `kms.key_id`.
- SCIM mapping simulation for at least Azure AD + Okta.
- smoke test: deploy to private-controlplane-canary and hit admin endpoints.

lex: checklist captured in the PR description. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/rbac/compare/refactor-2025 (will add commits).

claudia: Acceptance criteria for audit: every auth-affecting request must produce an audit event with these fields: `timestamp`, `actor.principal`, `actor.ip`, `actor.role`, `resource`, `action`, `outcome`, `kms.key_id` (if relevant). Also ensure logs are forwarded to customer syslog endpoint for private customers when configured.

john: one more: for on-prem installs where customers run the control plane, the role names must be configurable via env var so downstream packaging (helm/installs) can map to local admin conventions. Add `RBAC_ROLE_MAP` env and document it.

lex: noted. will add env var support and helm values. timeline: hotfix + staging today, canary tomorrow, full rollout Fri (subject to no regressions).

sam: sounds good. thumbs for staging deploy. :+1:

claudia: I'll push the XFF fix now and open the PR with tests. tagging @lex for review.

john: adding a note for product/security reviews: we should send a short customer comms draft for BYOK + role changes — people will ask about access and audits.

lex: will draft a one-pager for customers and legal. OK to close thread once PRs merged and canary green. Thanks everyone.
